trust_decision.summary: Which model columns a client may sort by (order_by) or filter on (structured where) through GET /api/{identity}: the fix limits them to visible list fields in sortable_fields/searchable_fields. At the pinned commit the query params go straight from base.py into the backend find_all/count with no check.

landing_point.why: The summary names the order_by parameter. _render_api is the only place that reads order_by/where from the query string and passes them to model.find_all.

fix_sites.entry_point: HTTP GET /api/{identity} (list and select2 modes), base.py:162-167

fix_sites.module_kind: core view base class (starlette_admin/views.py), where-dict field walker

fix_sites.entry_point: HTTP GET /api/{identity} via BaseModelView._validate_order_by (new; reworked at fix.diff:83-99)
HTTP GET /api/{identity} via BaseModelView._validate_where (new; reworked at fix.diff:101-122 to also require searchable_fields)
BaseModelView.__init__ (view construction at admin.add_view); the field-tree walk now records _all_fields, including ListField children (fix.diff:29-74), which the validators read

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: starlette_admin/views.py:268-306 (fix.diff:29-74): the construction-time field walk that builds the default searchable/sortable lists. The fix changed it to collect ListField children and keep _all_fields, which the validator uses instead of get_fields_list. Weak as a Pattern A site: it sits in the same file as the validators.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Per-backend query builders (contrib/*/helpers.py) are 'the ORM's own filter grammar'. Once top-level field names are validated, a solver can argue that nested keys inside a field's operator dict are operator syntax, not field names, and leave the builders alone.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The relation select2 widget calls the same /api route for the foreign model with select2=true and order_by='<pk> asc'. If the foreign view's pk is not in sortable_fields or is excluded from list, an over-broad order_by check breaks HasOne/HasMany pickers. Other behaviour that must keep working: relation sorting through sortable_field_mapping (the sort key is a relationship name), and plain-string full-text where, which the fix must not validate as a field name.

O6_input_shapes: order_by as a repeated query param (list), any element invalid (fix.diff:587-592)
order_by clause without a direction, which caused the 500 (fix.diff:556-560)
order_by field excluded from list or not in sortable_fields (fix.diff:567-581)
where JSON dict with a top-level field key (fix.diff:596-602)
where as a plain string (full-text) deliberately skipped (fix.diff:326, 644-647)

O7_producer.where: starlette_admin/views.py:268-306 builds the flattened field set and the default sortable/searchable lists at construction. The sqla backend pre-fills different defaults that exclude RelationField/FileField at starlette_admin/contrib/sqla/view.py:109-123.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Nested non-operator keys inside a field's value in a where dict: the validator collects only top-level and and/or/not keys, but every backend resolves a nested non-operator key as a fresh model attribute, so a hidden column can still be filtered when it sits under a visible field's key.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It looks like operator syntax handled by the ORM-specific builders. The published fix and its tests only consider top-level and logical keys.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: contrib/<backend>/helpers.py: 4 backend packages away from base.py/views.py

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Beanie full-text where uses a Mongo $text index when one exists, which matches every text-indexed field regardless of searchable_fields, so a string term can still probe non-searchable text fields.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The text index is the deployer's database configuration, and string where is explicitly not field-validated by the fix.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A backend-side _build_order_clauses that strips a '-'/'+' prefix or accepts a dotted embedded path before resolve_proxy, which differs from the name the validator compared.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The mongoengine/beanie builders already rewrite keys ('.'->'__', 'id'->'_id' at starlette_admin/contrib/beanie/helpers.py:176-177), so a prefix or alias normalisation is a natural maintainer addition.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An export or stored-state route that replays saved order_by/where (column state from stateSave) through find_all without calling _validate_*.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: _configs already exposes stateSave and export columns (starlette_admin/views.py:957-967). A server-side export endpoint reusing find_all is a plausible feature.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: sortable_field_mapping alias resolved before validation, or a mapping key that is not itself a list field.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The mapping is keyed by a field name but points to another model's column (User.name). Validating the alias rather than the target is a how-type gap.

O9_family: access control / info exposure via unvalidated sort-filter field names (CWE-639/CWE-200), plus an unhandled-exception 500 from a malformed order_by clause (CWE-248)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Check the top-level keys of where and the first token of each order_by clause against get_fields_list(LIST) in _render_api. This misses nested keys under a field and breaks select2 pk ordering if sortable_fields is also enforced naively.

out_of_scope_notes: A where JSON that is neither a dict nor a string (list/number) goes to the full-text branch with a non-str term; possible 500 on Mongo backends. Not pursued.
The pks branch (find_by_pks) of /api bypasses where/order_by entirely; it is a different property (row access by pk).
